name: Lake Brekken Campground
note: Turtle Lake Park District campground at the Brekken-Holmes Recreation Area on the east shore of Lake Brekken, 1.5 mi north of town beside the ballfield complex: open lawn and windbreak-sheltered pods along a gravel loop, with electric hookups (amperage unpublished). The Park District publishes nothing about it and the rate is camper-reported (Campendium, May 2025); call the City of Turtle Lake to confirm sites, rates and the season before going. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: ND HHS Statewide Licensed RV Parks/Campgrounds (updated 07.17.2025; hhs.nd.gov statewide-licensed-rv-parks-campgrounds-exception.pdf, read 2026-11-12) row 208: LAKE BREKKEN CAMPGROUND, 1575 9th St NW, Turtle Lake, McLean County, owner TURTLE LAKE PARK DISTRICT, licence to 12/31/2025, last inspection 6/26/2024, 21 lots -> an agency document naming it as a licensed campground (public ladder step 1). Reclamation's North Dakota recreation page (usbr.gov/gp/recreation/northdakota_recreation.html, read 2026-11-12) lists Brekken-Holmes as 'Managed by the Turtle Lake Park Board, Turtle Lake, ND 58575; (701) 250-4592' with a 'primitive campsites' icon; recreation.gov gateway 1124 (Brekken-Holmes Recreation Area, Reclamation, no bookable facilities). Operating: Campendium 'Brekken' (16th Ave NW, 47.547,-100.885) review of 2025-05-18: 'We were the only campers in early May. Electric only. Pit toilets. Beautiful setting!', nightly rate $20.00, site 2. Separate from 6053 Turtle Lake City Park: separate HHS licence (row 401 TURTLE LAKE CAMPGROUND, PO Box 338, same Park District, 12 lots), and 6053 is the in-town park on Eastside St ~3.1 km SSE, while this is 1.5 mi north of town on the lake. Esri imagery 2026-11-12 (3 km, 800 m and 300 m frames at 47.544,-100.890 / 47.5455,-100.8855 / 47.5468,-100.8862 / 47.5505,-100.8865): a gravel loop runs north from the ballfields along the east shore to a turnaround at the lake's NE corner, with open mown lawn, scattered tree rows, small shelters inside U-shaped windbreaks and one travel trailer parked in the north pod -> drive-in, open grass where a 23-ft rig fits. No horse facilities or mention, no road warning. Public (local): no price gate or presence rule. Not on RV Life (Algolia geo query 8 km, 2026-11-12: only 6053). Google Maps (2026-11-12): only 'Lake Brekken' (the lake, 4.7/10) and 'Lake Brekken Holmes Recreation Area' (park, 900 16th Ave NW, no reviews, no phone). Long-stay test 4: no count of nightly vs seasonal lots anywhere -> passes on no count; imagery shows one trailer in the whole area and the 2025 reviewer had the place to themselves in May.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: Esri World Imagery (3 km frame at 47.544,-100.890; 800 m at 47.5455,-100.8855; 700 m at 47.5505,-100.8865; 300 m at 47.5468,-100.8862 and 47.5445,-100.8880). No site map, numbered-site positions or official photos exist. The camping loop runs N-S about 60-110 m east of Lake Brekken's east shore; between road and water is open mown lawn falling to a brushy shoreline bank (continuous shrub band at the water's edge along most of the frontage); the shelter pods sit east of the road 110-250 m from the water inside U-shaped windbreaks, and the NE turnaround is ~40-80 m from the water across lawn with a shrub fringe. No pad identifiable within ~50 m of the water and the loop road lies between the pods and the lake -> not lakefront; the lake is in open view across the lawn from the whole loop (DEM: loop 558-563 m vs lake surface ~556 m, the loop slightly above the water, so not below a dam berm; Lake Brekken is a natural lake regulated by the Garrison Diversion, with no dam near the campground) -> lakeview.

fees.note: Camper-reported (Campendium review, May 2025); the Park District publishes no rate.

fees_source: https://maps.campendium.com/us/turtle-lake-nd/nature/brekken-turtle-lake-nd (review by camp-roadtripper820507 dated 2025-05-18: 'Nightly rate: $20.00', 'Site Number: 2', 'Electric only'), read 2026-11-12. Camper-reported: the operator has no web page (AWH 2026-10-11 rule).

sites.note: 21 licensed lots; electric hookups (amperage and water unpublished); open grass along a gravel loop.

sites_source: ND HHS Statewide Licensed RV Parks/Campgrounds (updated 07.17.2025) row 208, 21 lots; Campendium review 2025-05-18 ('Electric only'); Esri imagery read 2026-11-12
flags: Thin evidence: the Turtle Lake Park District has no web page, ndtourism refuses, and the city site (turtlelakend.org) only names Lake Brekken for fishing/boating. Existence rests on the 07.17.2025 HHS licence (21 lots, inspected 6/26/2024), Reclamation's page naming the Park Board as manager, and one dated Campendium review (May 2025). A phone-list candidate if AWH wants hookups, rate and season confirmed.

Phone: 701-448-2596 is the City of Turtle Lake (107 Eggert St, PO Box 338). The Park District's licence address for its other campground is that same PO Box 338, and AllStays gives this number for Lake Brekken. Reclamation's page gives (701) 250-4592 for the Park Board, which is a Bismarck exchange (Campendium/Dyrt also carry it) and may be Reclamation's own office.

Website: no operator page exists; given Reclamation's North Dakota recreation page (its Brekken-Holmes entry names the Turtle Lake Park Board). usbr.gov/gp/recreation/brekrec.html, the dedicated page, showed 'under maintenance' on 2026-11-12.

Pin: the HHS street address (1575 9th St NW) geocodes ~3 km west on the Census geocoder, off the campground; the pin is on the loop at the windbreak pods (Campendium's 47.547,-100.885), ~350 m N of the ballfields. Exactly which part of the loop holds the 21 lots is not published.
Waterfront: lakeview on imagery alone; lakefront is not supported because no pad can be placed within ~50 m of the water and the loop road separates the pods from the lake.
Hookups group not written: electric only is camper-reported with no amperage; AllStays also lists water and a dump, an aggregator claim left out.
curation_note: ND lead 12 (2026-11-12): separate from 6053 Turtle Lake City Park (own HHS licence LAKE BREKKEN CAMPGROUND, 21 lots, vs TURTLE LAKE CAMPGROUND, 12 lots, both Turtle Lake Park District; this is on Lake Brekken 1.5 mi N of town, 6053 the in-town park ~3.1 km SSE). Rate $20 is camper-reported (Campendium review 2025-05-18, site 2, electric only, pit toilets). Phone is the city's (Park District shares PO Box 338); Reclamation lists (701) 250-4592 for the Park Board. --Claude
